title: Superior proton conductivity and selectivity in sulfonated ionomer biocomposites containing renewably processed and fractionated lignin
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2333-2351
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00031A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xueting Wang, Mayura Silva, Colleen Clarke, Bronson Lynn, Mark Robertson, Aidan J. Leopold, Oreoluwa Agede, Lilin He, Stephen Creager, Mark E. Roberts, Mark C. Thies, Eric M. Davis
Herein, we have synthesized high-performance, low-cost ionomer biocomposites comprised of sulfonated poly(ether ether ketone) (SPEEK) and softwood Kraft lignin with proton selectivities three- to ten-fold higher than that of neat SPEEK.
